## Earnie 2.5.0-alpha.8

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5** line (follow-up to `2.5.0-alpha.7`). Focus: Smarthome-Backend (SB) as the live hub page — discovery, credentials, Loxone-Import, and Hauskonfigurator follow-ups.

### Highlights

- **Smarthome-Backend page** — mDNS/SSDP discovery, backend selection, and first-run setup on one page (`live_environment`)
- **Anbindung on SB** — credentials live on Smarthome-Backend; EHAL-Com keeps live debug/mapping only
- **Loxone-Import on SB** — success text points to Hauskonfigurator consumers and EHAL-Com mapping; HK no longer auto-opens a new house profile
- **Hausprofil Entfernen** — delete beside the profile select; Live-Szenario and in-use profiles are refused
- **Packaging icons** — LoxBerry plugin and Home-Assistant add-on use the simple light Earnie logo

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0-alpha.8` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.4.0**).
